headlines.title: Supreme Court hands preliminary win to Trump on mail-in ballots executive order
headlines.description: The Trump administration wants to exert greater control over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterms despite the primary role states play in overseeing elections.

headlines.title: How the new U.S. sanctions on Iran could affect China
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced new sanctions against Iran and said President Trump is imploring world leaders to join in on the "economic asphyxiation" of Tehran. Bessent said there would be no exemptions to the sanctions, which could indirectly affect China. Also, Bessent said President Trump would like Canada to return to trade talks in good faith. NBC News' Christine Romans and Monica Alba report.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to raise auto, truck and metal tariffs on Canada
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to raise tariffs on Canada for imported cars, trucks, automobile parts and steel after Canadian Prime Minister Carney said he would retaliate economically. NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez reports from the White House on the escalating trade tensions.

headlines.title: Judge in Lindsay Clancy case denies defense's motion for mistrial after witness brings up religion
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy's trial defense team requested a mistrial after a prosecution witness brought up Clancy's Catholic faith. The judge denied the motion, but instructed jurors to dismiss the comments and sent them home early. NBC Boston's Sue O'Connell reports.

headlines.title: Send in your questions on China, AI and robotics for Janis Mackey Frayer
headlines.description: NBC News’ correspondent, who has spent years in China, will answer reader questions in a Q&A for subscribers on Tuesday.

headlines.title: California attorney general cancels talks with Paramount, accuses company of leaks
headlines.description: Paramount insisted it has “not been the source of the leaks” about confidential talks with California, which sued to block the company’s merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.

headlines.title: As Ukraine’s allies gather for big anniversary, one key backer is absent
headlines.description: The lack of visible senior Trump administration participation was the latest sign of how Washington has backed off during a critical juncture for Ukraine.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze results from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff between Darline Graham and Ralph Norman, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: ‘Getting no help’: Thousands in Gary, Indiana, still without power nearly 2 weeks after storms
headlines.description: For some in Gary, Indiana, the lack of electricity nearly two weeks after storms has caused medical complications, while others are cooking what food they can at local parks before it spoils.

headlines.title: Why some Trump supporters aren’t sold on Darline Graham: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur digs into a key challenge for Sen. Darline Graham ahead of the South Carolina runoff.

headlines.title: Massachusetts woman wanted in police officer husband’s death believed to be dead
headlines.description: Karen Solomon, a Massachusetts mental health advocate for law enforcement who was being sought in connection with the death of her police officer husband, appears to have been found dead Monday, ending a multiday search.
